# Runs 6/7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B) first, then tones + Rxx-minimum filling factors.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
spots = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}   # n in 1e12 cm^-2 (run-5 geometry-scale cal)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain))
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12 (cal), F_L = {FL:.1f} T; R(B~0) {R[0]:.0f} Ohm, R(10 T) {R[-1]:.0f}; "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; |I_g| max {1e12*max(abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max(), abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()):.0f} pA")
    print(sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9).summary())
    Rs = gaussian_filter1d(R, 3 if rid == 6 else 1.5); m = B > 0.8
    pk, _ = find_peaks(-Rs[m], prominence=8); Bm = B[m][pk]
    print("Rxx minima B (T):", np.round(Bm, 2), "| nu at cal scale:", np.round(4 * FL / Bm, 1))
    ax[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, k].plot(Bm, Rs[m][pk], "rv", ms=5)
    ax[0, k].set_title(f"run {rid} raw Rxx(B), n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0"); ax[0, k].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, k].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    mm = B > 1.5
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[mm][:, None], B[mm], nfft=4096, bg_degree=5); ok = (f > 2) & (f < 2.5 * FL)
    ax[1, k].plot(f[ok], sp[0][ok] / sp[0][ok].max(), lw=1); ax[1, k].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L (cal) {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[1, k].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, k].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)"); ax[1, k].set_title(f"run {rid} FFT of log Rxx, B > 1.5 T"); ax[1, k].legend()
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6, 7).** Electron side (`data/6`, n = +3.2×10¹² at the run-5 geometry scale): deep QH by 7 T (Rxx ≈ 3 Ω minima at 7.16, 5.92, 4.27, 3.70 T), SdH from ≲ 1 T. Tones: **7.1 T** (onset censored at the 0.3 T record edge, i.e. a light pocket), **22.2 T** (onset 1.33 T, the strongest, SNR 100) and 29.5 T; 7.1 + 22.2 = 29.3 T ≈ 0.89 × F_L(cal) = 33.1 T. The Rxx-minimum sequence is **not periodic in 1/B** (Δ(1/B) grows 0.029 → 0.037 across 7 → 3 T), which a single 4-fold Fermi surface would not give and two interleaved LL ladders would. Hole side (`data/7`, n = −1.2×10¹²): no Rxx zeros up to 10 T (minima 90–220 Ω at 4.9–8.3 T), tones 6.6 / 4.7 / 8.5 / 12.3 T, messy near the CNP.

**Take:** (i) the 29.3–29.5 T total vs 33.1 T says the geometry-prior density scale reads ~11 % high. The (n, D) scale is **not yet calibrated**; the fan's QH lines will set it. (ii) Two pockets at ≈ 0.24 / 0.76 of the total density on the electron side fit the Bernal (ABAB) two-bilayer-band split (light/heavy ≈ 0.28/0.72 in the minimal model). But 22.2 T and 29.5 T also sit within 4 % of 3× and 4× 7.1 T, so a single-trace FFT cannot exclude harmonics. **Not a call.** The Landau fan (n × B at D = 0) separates the options: two independent tone families with F₁(n) + F₂(n) = F_L(n) and LL crossings (ABAB), vs one family at F_L with a clean 4-fold ladder (ABCA), vs a gapped / D-asymmetric CNP (ABCB).

## HERA — Step 4: D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`) — n × B, the stacking discriminator

> **05:25** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.24e12 (cal) 150 pts co-swept Vtg/Vbg x B 1->10 T 137 rows (1/B-uniform to 3.1 T, 0.1 T above), Vsi 0, sr1 100 uV, fast 1.0 s; ends 10 T · **ETA ~14:25** (≈9h)

**Why this, now (plan step 4).** The spot checks (runs 6/7, ana cells 14–16) show SdH from ≲ 1 T and deep QH by 7 T on the electron side. The tones there are 7.1 + 22.2 T (sum 29.3 ≈ 0.89 F_L) plus 29.5 T, and the Rxx minima are **not periodic in 1/B**. That leans Bernal (two bilayer-like pockets ≈ 0.24/0.76) but is ambiguous: 22 and 29.5 T sit within 4 % of 3× and 4× the 7.1 T tone. A single trace can't separate these; a fan can. Along n it should show whether there are two tone families with F₁(n) + F₂(n) = F_L(n) and LL crossings (ABAB) or one family at F_L on a clean 4-fold ladder (ABCA). The QH fan-line slopes also give the **density scale**, which is still the geometry prior and reads ~11 % high.

**Design.** Fast axis: n along the run-5-calibrated **D = 0** line, co-swept (V_tg, V_bg), −1.25 … +3.24×10¹² (cal units), 150 pts (Δn = 0.030; ≥ 6 pts per 4-fold period at 1.5 T). Every point is asserted inside the validators. Slow axis: **B 1 → 10 T**, uniform in 1/B (Δ = 0.0101 T⁻¹, FFT Nyquist ≈ 50 T) up to 3.1 T, then 0.1 T steps to 10 T, 137 rows. The first half serves the per-n FFT; the second half resolves QH fan lines and crossings. Starts where the magnet sits (0 T) and ends at **10 T** with gates at the e-side end, so step 5 rides the field down and nothing is re-traversed. `sr1` is fixed at **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS** (the handoff's state0 restore left it at 2 µV); fast_delay 1.0 s at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, same as run 5. Guards: |I_gate| > 1 nA → interrupt + park gates; T_sample > 3 K → interrupt.

**Coverage trades, stated.** (i) Hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² and the electron side at +3.24×10¹²: the TG limits (−0.3 / +1.0 V) end the D = 0 line there. There is no way to widen this within the operating box. (ii) B < 1 T is excluded. Only the light 7 T tone lives there, and extending uniform-1/B to 0.5 T would add ~100 rows ≈ 5 h. (iii) The ν = 0 CNP state at high B may exceed 10 kΩ and rail a few columns around n ≈ 0. I accept that: the discriminating content is at |n| ≳ 0.3×10¹². (iv) Monodirectional fast sweeps plus ~4τ lock-in lag give a uniform ≈ +1-point (0.03×10¹²) n shift, corrected in analysis.

**Price.** From run 5: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1 s, +0.05 s for the second gate write, so 1.15 s/pt. Per row: 150 × 1.15 + 3 s slow_delay + ~3.5 s flyback + 3 s magnet settle ≈ 182 s, × 137 rows ≈ 6.9 h. Add field ramps (1 → 10 T at 0.137 T/min = 66 min), the 0 → 1 T ramp (7.5 min) and gate ramps: ≈ 8.2 h, **headline ~9 h** with the ~8 % session overrun.

**Checkpoints.** *First rows* (≈ 15 min in, rows 1–2 at 1.0 T): no rail away from the CNP, CNP peak near n ≈ 0 (confirms the D = 0 path), gate currents at the ~100 pA baseline, T at base. *Row ≈ 45* (B ≈ 1.8 T, ~2.7 h): partial per-column FFT over the landed rows, looking for the light tone vs n. *Row ≈ 90* (B ≈ 5.5 T, ~5.8 h): fan-line slopes → density scale; crossings present or absent. At each checkpoint I decide continue / abandon; the price of the remaining rows is on the watch ETA.

# === D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`), plan step 4: n fast along the calibrated D = 0 line, B slow 1 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (ratio data-calibrated; absolute scale = geometry prior, ~11 % high per runs 6/7) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.24, 150)                       # 1e12 cm^-2 (cal units), 0.030 step
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.round(Vtg_vec, 5), np.round(Vbg_vec, 5)
assert (Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN) and (Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX) and (Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN) and (Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX), \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_rt, _D_rt = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}); "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; roundtrip max|D| {np.abs(_D_rt).max():.1e} V/nm")

# --- slow: uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) = 0.0101 /T, Nyquist ~50 T) 1.0 -> 3.1 T, then uniform 0.1 T 3.2 -> 10 T ---
B_vec = np.round(np.hstack((field_invB(1.0, 3.1, 68), np.arange(3.2, 10.0001, 0.1))), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (68 uniform-1/B to 3.1 T, then 0.1 T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05, handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0

# --- lock-ins: state0 restore left sr1 at 2 uV; fixed 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA for the whole fan (no mid-row autorange) ---
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz -> {sr1.amplitude()/100e6*1e9:.1f} nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB")
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 3.0
tripped = []

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (150, run-5 cal) co-swept (Vtg, Vbg); "
                  f"B slow 1->10 T (68 uniform-1/B to 3.1 T + 0.1 T to 10 T, 137 rows); Vsi 0; sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, 150 pts, fast = co-swept (k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt) along D = 0; '
              f'B 1 -> 10 T, 137 rows (uniform 1/B 1-3.1 T, 0.1 T 3.2-10 T); cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.3e}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm (density scale uncalibrated, ~11 % high per runs 6/7); '
              f'Vsi 0; sr1 100 uV fixed; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; tau 0.3 s / 24 dB')

# gates to the fan start at B = 0, then the field to the first row
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
print(f"gates at fan start: Vtg {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg {k_bg.volt():+.4f}; ramping field {magnet.field():+.3f} -> {B_vec[0]} T (~7.5 min, blocking)")
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
print(f"field at {magnet.field():+.4f} T")

# row layout: [time, magnet_field(slow), k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt (fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_tg.curr); s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)
_F0 = 4   # first followed column

def guard(station, data):
    T, i_tg, i_bg = float(data[_F0]), abs(float(data[_F0 + 1])), abs(float(data[_F0 + 2]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        tripped.append(("leak", float(data[1]), float(data[2]), float(data[3]))); station.interrupt_requested = True
    elif T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        tripped.append(("T", float(data[1]), T)); station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    if any(t[0] == "leak" for t in tripped):
        print("leak trip -> parking gates at 0 (field held where it is)")
        s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end state: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg = {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg = {k_bg.volt():+.4f}, T = {T_sample():.3f} K; trips: {tripped}")
# Normal completion: field stays at 10 T and gates at the fan's e-side end — plan step 5 rides the field down from here.
